Lab occupancy - whether the 77.7% first-quarter-2026 level is the trough management says it is, converting the "2 million square foot pipeline" into commenced rent, or whether the Gateway campus - which "has more than 500,000 square feet of vacancy in a prime location" - and the 2027 renewal book push the recovery past 2027 and make the "'26 is the bottom" call a year early.

CONVERSION, not trough - the 2026Q2 print settled the old hinge (lab total occupancy inflected a second consecutive quarter to 78.5%, already past the full-year "at least 100 basis points" goal at the half), so the thesis now hinges on whether occupancy gains convert into segment NOI and a 2027 earnings re-acceleration - "So I think it's probably a little too soon to predict exactly which quarter we'll see that inflection, but we're certainly trending in the right direction."
